android.desc:
Bookmarq is a clean, privacy first bookmark manager built for simplicity and speed.

🌐 Save Anything Instantly
Add links from any app using the Share menu. No account, no sync, your bookmarks stay on your device.

🔖 Tag & Organize
Group links with custom tags. Find anything fast with smart search by title, URL, or tag.

📱 Designed for Mobile
A distraction free, mobile first interface that just works — no ads, no bloat, no tracking.

🛡 Your Data Stays Yours
Bookmarq runs 100% locally. No cloud storage, no data collection, no analytics.

✨ Minimal but Powerful
Save from browser or apps
Fast local search
Works offline
Lightweight and battery friendly

show_hn.title: Show HN: Bookmarq.space – One Place for Everything You Save

quotes.text:
I kept running into the same problem. I’d save a workout I wanted to try, a recipe video I loved, or a short article I meant to read later… and when I actually wanted it, I had no idea where I’d saved it.

Some things were in Instagram saved posts. Others in YouTube likes. Some were buried in my Notes app or screenshots. I’d spend more time looking for them than using them.

So I made Bookmarq — a simple place to keep everything I save. Reels, shorts, blogs, recipes, articles. All in one spot. I can tag them, search them, and actually find them again.

No logins. No accounts. No ads. Just my stuff, organized and easy to reach.

I built this to fix my own mess, but I’m sharing it in case anyone else is tired of losing the things they save.

Download App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bookmarqspace.app
Website: https://bookmarq.space
